title: Master Your Sleep & Be More Alert When Awake
takeaway: Cahaya biru layar malam hari menunda melatonin 2-3 jam. Wajib cut-off gadget sebelum Isya agar jam 3 melek tanpa pusing (bukti ilmiah hadits Nabi ﷺ).
